Extract every distinct Mastercard Day store benefit on the page. Rules: (1) Return each offer ONCE — the page repeats each benefit in Hebrew and in expanded text; merge duplicates of the same store+offer into a single entry. (2) store_name: use the brand's Latin/English name when the brand has one (e.g. 'Adidas', "McDonald's", 'Aeroflex', 'Opticana', 'Nine West'); otherwise the Hebrew name as shown. (3) deal_description: the full benefit text in Hebrew. (4) price_text: the discount as a percent or shekel amount (e.g. '20%', '50 ₪'); empty if none. Ignore navigation, category headers, footer links, and generic banners; return only real store offers.

For each: store_name = the store-name text exactly as shown including both languages and the '|', WITHOUT the URL (e.g. 'Soltam | סולתם', 'AliExpress | אליאקספרס'); price_text = the cashback text exactly as shown (e.g. '3% קאשבק', 'עד 11% קאשבק'); deal_description = the same cashback text; detail_url = the URL in parentheses on the store-name line (e.g. '/store/Aliexpress/1786'). Ignore the 'לפרטים נוספים' and 'לקנייה' lines.
